Grants an app the permission to modify or delete media files created by other apps without needing to ask for user confirmation for each individual file.
Grants an app the ability to route or transfer audio and video playback to different output devices, such as Bluetooth speakers or remote screens.

Determines whether an app is permitted to automatically launch or execute actions when the device scans a compatible Near Field Communication (NFC) tag.

Allows admin users to manage all users on the device, including creating new users or guests, deleting existing users, switching between users, and modifying multiuser-related preferences. Separately, it allows each user to control their own settings, such as changing their name and avatar or deleting their own account.

Allows users to manage the device\'s date, time, and time zone settings. This includes configuring automatic date, time, and time zone detection; manually setting the date, time, and time zone; configuring if location should be used to determine the time zone; and choosing between 12-hour and 24-hour time formats. Users can also configure whether to receive notifications for time zone changes or upcoming scheduled clock changes, such as Daylight Saving Time.

Allows users to manage their screen lock settings. This includes setting or modifying their device credential, like a PIN or password, as well as managing their biometrics and other authenticators, like watches, and related preferences for each of these modalities.
Allows users to enable and disable input method editors and to invoke settings activities specific to each input method editor.
